This is a '''list of [[aircraft manufacturer]]s''' sorted alphabetically by [[International Civil Aviation Organization]] (ICAO)/common name. It contains the ICAO/common name, manufacturers name(s), country and other data, with the known years of operation in parentheses.

The ICAO names are listed in '''bold'''. Having an ICAO name does not mean that a manufacturer is still in operation today. Just that some of the aircraft produced by that manufacturer are still flying.
